hideLabel.description: Keeps the label for screen readers only.

value.description: Controlled amount in minor units (cents for USD, yen for JPY). null is empty.

defaultValue.description: Starting amount in minor units when uncontrolled.

onValueChange.description: Called with minor units and { currency, major, formatted }.

onCurrencyChange.description: Called when a currency is picked. The major amount carries over.

currencies.description: Codes in the currency menu. Pass one code to hide the menu.

min.description: Lowest amount in minor units. Checked when the field loses focus.

max.description: Highest amount in minor units. Typing past it is refused with a nudge.

quickAdd.description: Quick add chips in major units. Pass an empty array to hide them.

step.description: Arrow keys move by this many minor units. Defaults to one major unit; Shift moves ten times as far.

locale.description: Formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client render the same digits.

disabled.description: Disables the field, menu, and chips.

name.description: Adds a hidden input carrying the amount in minor units.

onBlur.description: Called when the input loses focus, after the fraction settles.
